name: Anthropology of Disability
description: Situating anthropology of disability in the discipline; disability and cross-cultural perspectives on personhood; ethnographic perspectives on disability from global South; disability, life writing and autoethnography; anthropological perspectives on disability and neurodiversity; disability and the question of body: explorations using ethnographic texts; disability and religion: exploring the entanglements; disability and the ethnographer’s body; disability, care and kinship; disability and environment.
